messages:
Maya: heads up — we need a clear precedence model for header-driven routing + alias pinning. e.g. if route rule sets X-Model: redwood-large and user header X-Model-Alias: gpt-4ish, which wins? Also quota behaviour and canary rollout UX.
Dan: we should make routing priority explicit: 1) explicit route config pin, 2) tenant header, 3) alias mapping, 4) fallback. Route-config override should always win unless admin flag allows header override.
Chi: telemetry question — how do we show when header overrides have occurred in console? Need per-request annotations + histogram of override rates.
Aisha: agree. also compatibility constraints: if alias maps to v2.1 but route pin requires >=v3.0, we should reject or fallback? prefer reject with audit so caller can fix.
Maya: yes — prefer fail-fast for incompatible pins, but allow soft-fallback with a metric if configured. UX can be a toggle in rollout policies.
Dan: example rule snippet:
```yaml
match:
  path: /generate
  headers:
    X-Tenant: tenant-a
  route_overrides:
    model_alias: "conv-1"
    allow_header_override: false
priority: 10
fallback:
  alias: "small-cpu"
weights:
  conv-1: 80
  small-cpu: 20
```
Chi: If we add weighted aliases, we must tie weights to quota buckets. Otherwise one alias might exhaust reserved qps and cause surprising fallbacks.
Aisha: +1. Implementation idea: evaluate weights at routing time, then consult per-alias capacity estimates. If alias capacity insufficient, remap weight to fallback or autoscale signal.
Maya: UX for console: show effective model per route, and annotate overrides with a tooltip listing header values and who allowed header overrides. Also add a 'Simulate traffic' button.
Dan: ops note — deploy-bot will ship a prototype rule eval in staging tomorrow.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: routing-eval/prototype -> staging @ 2109876600 :rocket:
Chi: tests: add e2e that sends X-Model-Alias and X-Tenant combos, assert strict/reject behaviors and fallback paths. Also check telemetry tags: routing.override and routing.fallback.reason.
Maya: I'll draft a doc for the console language and error codes; ping me for review.
Aisha: I'll draft compatibility matrix for current model families.
Maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
